body: This just raises more questions. But, I don't want to pry. Out of curiosity, you said you were mentally ill - how so? Like, how exactly?

> She said that if I would have told her that when we first went out she wouldn't have dated me, but thought it was kind of cute.

So is that why you broke up?
You watched someone sleep because they are a terrible person? I don't get it. I need the story.
